findings.title: A '待核对' hedge before the value short-circuits BOTH the mismatch check and the new explicit-unknown path, so a mismatched ratio is still delivered silently
findings.evidence: In the prose loop the already-withheld-cell guard is `elif re.match(r"\s*(?:为|是|=|：|:)?\s*待核对(?:[,，。；;]|\s+vs\s+|$)", remainder): continue`. `continue` skips the rest of the per-period body, i.e. `_prose_number`, the ranking preface, the new `unlocated` computation AND `failure_code`. Counterexample with products {'2026-06-30': {1.588}} and an l3 trace: draft `收入可核[E1]，2026中报含金量待核对，实际为1.587。` -> periods=[2026中报], parallel={}, remainder=`待核对，实际为1.587。` matches the guard (待核对 followed by '，') -> continue -> the clause produces NO finding at all. calculation_copy_findings returns (), _recheck_research_delivery returns the outcome unchanged, so the mismatched 1.587 is public with no 待核对 on it, no `calculation_value_unlocated`/`calculation_value_mismatch`, no gap notice, no partial downgrade and no same-turn repair. `2026中报含金量为待核对，实际为1.587。` behaves identically. This is reachable in the very loop this patch depends on: the repair note tells the model to leave an explicit gap, so a repair-turn draft of the form '…为待核对，实际为1.587' passes the post-repair recheck and can settle at completed. The reviewed baseline d38dab3f also emitted nothing for this exact input (its regex likewise failed to match a number right after 待核对), so the user-visible outcome is pre-existing rather than a regression; the guard branch itself is new in this cumulative diff. It is reported as medium because it is a bypass of the contract this request establishes ('不静默放行') and of docs/agent-product-door.md's new sentence, and because the marker used for idempotence doubles as a suppression vector.
findings.recommendation: Do not `continue` out of the whole period body on a 待核对 hedge: treat the withheld marker as covering only the value slot, then keep scanning the remainder of the clause (mismatch check plus the `unlocated` residual scan) so a number that follows the hedge is either marked 待核对 or reported as calculation_value_unlocated. Add `2026中报含金量待核对，实际为1.587。` and `…为待核对，实际为1.587。` as regressions, add a mutation that flips the guard, and state the chosen rule in docs/agent-product-door.md.

findings.title: The unlocated marker is clause-wide: it prefixes independently sourced facts and citations and fires on any unresolved bare number in the clause
findings.evidence: `if unlocated: insertion = offset + clause.start()` inserts `〔比率对应关系待核对〕` at the START of the whole _CLAUSE (which ends only at 。！？；;\n). The independently executed mutation log shows the delivered form: `〔比率对应关系待核对〕收入可核[E1]，2026中报含金量3年新高，该值为1.587。` — the marker leads the answer and syntactically scopes over the sourced fact `收入可核[E1]`, not over the ratio phrase. The trigger is also clause-wide: `residual` is computed from `remainder`, which runs to the end of the clause, so a number belonging to a DIFFERENT, correctly bound period sets the flag (`2026中报含金量3年最高，2025中报含金量为0.289。` marks the sentence although 0.289 is located and matches), and any bare number without a recognised unit suffix does too (`2026中报含金量的口径见附注3。` -> residual `的口径见附注3。` -> '3' has no _NON_RATIO_SUFFIX -> marker, partial, repair). The committed controls only survive because their numbers carry units (`第3位` via 位, `123亿元` via 亿), i.e. false positives are held off by a finite unit lexicon. All of this is fail-closed (no false fact is published) and the door discloses that the mark '不证明数字错误，只声明未核准'.
findings.recommendation: Anchor the marker to the ratio phrase (e.g. insert at the period/ratio label match rather than clause.start()) and restrict the residual scan to the segment before the next period label, so a neighbouring period's located value cannot raise the flag; add the two over-marking inputs as pinned regressions whichever behavior you choose.

findings.title: A correct ratio value in an unsupported phrasing is downgraded to 'unverified', and a stale marker is never cleared
findings.evidence: `_prose_number` plus the finite preface `\s*(?:创)?\d+(?:年|个?季|个?月)(?:新高|新低|高点|低点)[,，]\s*(?:实际|本期|比率)为` recognise only a small set of connectors, so `2026中报含金量3年最高，为1.588。` (1.588 IS the product) yields number=None, residual '为1.588。' -> unlocated -> marker, status completed->partial, one repair consumed for an answer that was right. Symmetrically, once a clause carries the marker the check never removes it: if a later revision makes the value locatable and matching, `unlocated` is False, no finding is produced and the stale `〔比率对应关系待核对〕` stays in the delivered text with no accompanying notice. Both directions are conservative rather than unsafe, and the door says the mark does not certify an error.
findings.recommendation: Either widen the accepted value connectors (该值为/为…的/最高/最低) with regressions, or record in the product door that legitimate correct values in unrecognised phrasings are deliberately reported as unverified; and consider emitting a finding that strips a marker whose clause no longer has an unlocated value.
